lines: Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, inspected the birds. "Why do I not see the hoopoe, or is he among the absent?"
A king who notices one small bird missing. He said the hoopoe would be punished, unless it brought a clear reason.
"I have learned what you have not learned, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news."
What news could a bird bring to a prophet?
